mappings.reason: A dose-response study is a use of the existing controlled clinical-study method, informed by the separately authored exposure-response model.
Product identity and clinical qualification apply existing medicine quality and trial methods; a contrast use does not create a separate universal qualification mechanism.
Reconciling complementary and conflicting imaging evidence is an application of differential diagnosis with qualified registration, not a new reasoning method.
External validation of a clinical predictor applies the shared model-validation mechanism with diagnostic performance and decision evidence; a clinical prefix does not add a distinct validation law.

scope_distinctions.distinction: Organizing renal care differs from the actual extracorporeal membrane and peritoneal exchange mechanisms; each route needs its own qualified supplies and staffing.
Timed stimulation, a therapeutic rhythm intervention and mechanical blood-flow support serve different physical functions; none substitutes for the others.

Sustained intensive-care gas-exchange support and a qualified operative bypass service share components but differ in operating envelope, integration and staffing. Shared components should be manufactured once, not duplicated by service name.
Tracer distribution and two physically distinct emission-detection/reconstruction systems are separate mechanisms, with shared tracer quality and clinical interpretation requirements.
